'''Starfall''' was a country estate south of [[Tahv]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], owned by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Candra Kitai]] around [[3960 BBY]]. It contained a [[Marble/Legends|marble]] mansion, which served as the home for the [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] and her [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Lost">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref>
